responsibility: Implements the Linux target helper that reports libc-provided function availability to GCC. The linux_libc_has_function hook answers whether classes of builtin/library functions can be assumed present based on the selected Linux libc model, treating glibc and musl as broadly complete and modeling Bionic as only providing specific C94/C99 miscellaneous and sincos-related classes. This file is a small target-capability query implementation used by optimizers and builtin expansion, not the main Linux specs layer.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the linux same-name group: it only defines the linux_libc_has_function runtime-capability hook that answers builtin/libc availability for glibc, musl, and Bionic, whereas gcc/config/linux.h sets the broader Linux libc-selection, dynamic-linker, builtin, and include-path policy and gcc/config/linux.opt declares the -mglibc/-muclibc/-mbionic/-mmusl options.
